text: Testing plays a vital role in creating reliable software. Unit tests check individual pieces of code, like functions or classes, to ensure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work together smoothly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally improve the code. This approach encourages clear thinking and better design. Overall, a solid testing strategy gives developers confidence, making it easier to add new features or fix bugs without worry. Good tests also protect the system from future mistakes.
